responsibility: Declares the macro-expansion unwinding hooks used by text diagnostics for libcpp-based front ends. It exposes the helper to append an expansion trace for a location and the virt_loc_aware_text_finalizer callback that front ends can chain into their text finalization path to print macro definition and expansion notes after a diagnostic.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration layer for the macro-unwinding pair: it exposes the text finalizer and macro-trace helper APIs, while macro-unwinding.cc contains the actual line-map traversal and note-emission logic.
